bullets.text: overcast held all morning. not rain, not clearing. the sky filed for an extension and nobody argued.
duck reached nagao-ji, eighty-seven of eighty-eight, one temple from the end. a camphor leaf fell. the cloud stayed put. ☁️
swapping summer strings on a guitar that only gets played when the house is empty. the house is empty.
the neighbor's wind chime rang once at noon with no wind around to take the blame.
today's profits are tomorrow's debts, someone wrote once. the ledger doesn't care who reads it back.
